cat > /tmp/tree_fuzz.py <<'PY'
import sys,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import engine

class P:
 def __init__(self,o,r,l=1,id=None):
  self.id=id if id is not None else o; self.ordinal=o; self.rank=r; self.key=(r,o); self.length=l; self.prio=engine._splitmix64(o ^ 0xD1B54A32D192ED03)

rng=random.Random(999)
# FIFO
for trial in range(100):
 f=None; arr=[]; saved=[]
 for step in range(500):
  op=rng.randrange(5)
  if op<=1 or not arr:
   o=(max([p.ordinal for p in arr],default=-1)+1)
   p=P(o,rng.randrange(10),rng.randint(1,10)); arr.append(p); f=engine.f_insert_last(f,p)
  elif op==2:
   k=rng.randrange(len(arr)+1)
   a,b=engine.f_split_count(f,k)
   al=engine.f_collect(a); bl=engine.f_collect(b)
   assert [p.ordinal for p in al]==[p.ordinal for p in arr[:k]]
   assert [p.ordinal for p in bl]==[p.ordinal for p in arr[k:]]
  elif op==3:
   p=rng.choice(arr); arr.remove(p); f=engine.f_delete(f,p.ordinal)
  else:
   saved.append(f)
  assert [p.ordinal for p in engine.f_collect(f)]==[p.ordinal for p in arr]
  assert (f.bytes if f else 0)==sum(p.length for p in arr)
  if saved and op==4:
   f=rng.choice(saved); arr=engine.f_collect(f)
print('fifo tree ok')
# PIFO
for trial in range(100):
 pif=None; arr=[]; saved=[]
 for step in range(500):
  op=rng.randrange(6)
  if op<=1 or not arr:
   o=rng.randrange(10000); r=rng.randrange(20)
   # ensure unique key
   while any(p.key==(r,o) for p in arr): o+=1
   p=P(o,r,rng.randint(1,15)); arr.append(p); pif=engine.p_insert(pif,p)
  elif op==2:
   p,new=engine.p_pop_min(pif); arr.remove(p); pif=new
  elif op==3:
   p=rng.choice(arr); arr.remove(p); pif=engine.p_delete(pif,p.key)
  elif op==4:
   cap=rng.randint(1,60)
   a,b=engine.p_take_prefix(pif,cap)
   al=engine.p_collect(a); bl=engine.p_collect(b)
   s=0; k=0
   for p in sorted(arr,key=lambda x:x.key):
    if s+p.length<=cap: s+=p.length; k+=1
    else: break
   assert [p.key for p in al]==[p.key for p in sorted(arr,key=lambda x:x.key)[:k]]
   assert [p.key for p in bl]==[p.key for p in sorted(arr,key=lambda x:x.key)[k:]]
   assert (a.bytes if a else 0)==sum(p.length for p in al)
  else:
   saved.append(pif)
  assert [p.key for p in engine.p_collect(pif)]==sorted(p.key for p in arr)
  assert (pif.bytes if pif else 0)==sum(p.length for p in arr)
  if saved and op==5:
   pif=rng.choice(saved); arr=engine.p_collect(pif)
print('pifo tree ok')
# Global
for trial in range(100):
 g=None; live={}; saved=[]
 for step in range(700):
  op=rng.randrange(7)
  if op<=1 or not live:
   o=rng.randrange(100000); r=rng.randrange(30)
   while any(p.key==(r,o) for p in live.values()): o+=1
   p=P(o,r,rng.randint(1,10)); live[p.id]=p; p.lag=0
   # IDs unique only because o, but can collide across deleted? use o high; okay
   g=engine.g_insert(g,p)
  elif op==2:
   p=rng.choice(list(live.values())); del live[p.id]; g=engine.g_delete(g,p.key)
  elif op==3:
   r=rng.randrange(31)
   cnt,g=engine.g_less_rank_and_increment(g,r)
   exp=sum(1 for p in live.values() if p.rank<r)
   assert cnt==exp,(cnt,exp)
   for p in live.values():
    if p.rank<r: p.lag+=1
  elif op==4:
   p=rng.choice(list(live.values()))
   lag,stored=engine.g_get_lag(g,p.key)
   assert lag==p.lag,(lag,p.lag,p.id)
  else:
   saved.append(g)
  # verify all lags
  got=dict(engine.g_collect_lags(g))
  exp={p.id:p.lag for p in live.values()}
  assert got==exp,(got,exp)
  if saved and op>=5:
   g=rng.choice(saved)
   # Need reconstruct live from g; lags embedded in nodes
   live={}
   for id,lag in engine.g_collect_lags(g):
    # find packet in saved tree traversal
    p=None
    # collect with lags doesn't return pkt, manually locate by id map impossible; use keys? create mapping from all packets by id globally
    pass
   # Instead rebuild live using a global all_packets registry
print('global basic ok (without restore live reconstruction)')
